apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 207 adds optional client frame interpolation without a resolution cap, retaining the 60 FPS limit and slow-GPU fallback. Includes NIS, AMD FSR1, balanced pacing and adaptive HDR (requires source metadata). Controls in Settings → Stream and HUD → Picture. Retains Metal 4 pacing/rendering and controller/rumble changes. Optional features default off. GPU checks including 2560×1080 interpolation, simulator eligibility test and Release archive passed; physical gameplay needs testing. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
